d: Short honey-blonde hair with blunt bangs and a small side braid, paired with wide, bright lime-green eyes and a youthful, adolescent facial expression. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a green and orange tunic with white trim, brown shorts with small white bows, a long lime-green cape featuring brown X-shaped stitching, and brown calf-high boots. Accessories include gold wrist cuffs, a white bow in the hair, and a white ribbon tied at the waist.
